subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before any candidate PR closes https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95734?
rationale: The documented `--bind <channel>:<account>` syntax is currently account-scoped, while the reported Feishu group IDs need peer bindings; choosing the permanent grammar or plugin hook is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer handling
options.body: Keep documented account binds working and add an explicit peer grammar or plugin-owned conversation-id hook with docs, tests, and an account escape.

options.title: Accept Feishu two-segment reinterpretation
options.body: Treat `feishu:<value>` as a peer by default only if maintainers accept the upgrade risk and require migration/docs proof.

options.title: Pause this candidate for a sibling fix
options.body: Pick another open candidate if it better matches the desired grammar, then close the remaining PRs only after a viable fix merges.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer handling
recommendation.body: Keep documented account binds working and add an explicit peer grammar or plugin-owned conversation-id hook with docs, tests, and an account escape.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the command surface that introduced the current account-scoped bind behavior.
